variants.headline: Household savings committed to a company plan
variants.sub: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}.
variants.body:
The settler {founder} has put household savings into a plan for {business} in {district}. The commitment is a plan to start a company, not an announcement that it has opened. For {target}, the relevant question concerns the conditions under which a household commits its means to an undertaking.

The gazette records the plan and the commitment of household savings. Planning a company and beginning its operations are distinct stages. The public account should preserve that distinction while recognising that a proposal can already represent a material commitment by the person seeking to establish it.

We support {target} in this assessment. A household's commitment to an undertaking deserves a fair hearing, and a plan should not be dismissed simply because its future has not yet become an established result. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: A settler backs a business idea
variants.sub: The settler {founder} has committed household savings to a plan for {business}.

Any reckoning with {target} should distinguish respect for that commitment from a promise that the enterprise will open or produce a particular result.
